verdict_word: Big revenue beat and ARR more than doubled, but 2026 slides to the low end

headline.metric: Annualized run-rate revenue (ARR), end of Sept.

takeaways: Revenue jumped 571% to $980.8 million; the AI cloud business was $973.8 million, about 99% of the total, per the company release and shareholder letter.
ARR hit $6.4 billion at the end of September, up 113% from $3.0 billion in June. Then Nebius said it 'no longer sees ARR as the right measure' of the business.
Some 2026 revenue is slipping into early 2027, so the company now expects the low end of its $3.0-3.4 billion range, and the December ARR target now arrives in February.
Prepayments on deals signed in Q3 covered more than 100% of the associated capex, up from 50-60% in Q2; payback improved to 1 year 7 months.
First 2027 outlook: $12-13 billion revenue, $40-45 billion capex, and pre-tax breakeven by the end of 2027. Q3 capex alone was $7.3 billion.
verdict: Nebius beat on sales, doubled its run-rate in a quarter, and got customers to prepay for the buildings. Then it quietly retired the ARR number right as the December target slid to February. Big quarter, slightly moving goalposts, and the stock is up anyway.
